evidence_boundaries: Yang is a Geant4 response-surface optimization; 90 percent is conversion-screen optical response share, not thermal-neutron fluence share or gamma-ray purity. MC call counts are not measured wall-clock acceleration.
Hobmaier uses first-principles transport and bounded TTM; literature ablation comparisons are not new experiments, and 6.4 is the ratio of each material heat-conductivity maximum.
McCright directly measures UMER currents, but local full text is 2025 arXiv v1 linked to a 2026 APS accepted record. Official VOR remains unavailable; Figure 4 label/axis discrepancies retained.

Wang is fixed-opacity/conductivity 1D radiation MHD. Impact-time outgoing-power changes are not peak or integrated-radiation improvements; percentage denominator and unreadable source plot labels are documented.
Banks is synthetic linear-advection training on A100, not PIC or plasma validation. 3.75x observed 2D training scan, roughly 580x theoretical only; 3D epochs conflict retained.
No physics solver, transport optimization, DFT/TTM, raw-data fit or neural training was rerun locally.
